fact: Each designer drafts from the same taskbook, baseline, and fact snapshot without seeing the other designers’ drafts.
In Compare, each Designer reads both frozen peer drafts and returns separate lists of proposed Goal or Fact changes addressed to their authors.
The plugin collects all three Compare results before delivering any change requests to draft authors.
In Respond, each Designer accepts or counters every request on its draft by issue and draft version.
In Reconcile, the two peers review the author's counterproposal. Two accepts resolve it for Synthesize. Only issues with a new counter return to Respond.
